title: Unescaped HTML sink $(el).html(payload) (javascript) — review required
description: The javascript sink $(el).html(payload) writes a value into HTML without escaping. If the value contains untrusted input, attacker markup and scripts run in victims' browsers. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms the value is trusted or escaped.
remediation: Escape the value for its HTML context (text() binding or a sanitizer) or bind it as text, never markup. Only trusted constant markup may bypass escaping.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any $(el).html(payload) call matches, including trusted constant markup. Whether the value is attacker-controlled needs human review.
